categories.main_business_segments: WuXi Unicomp Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and service of industrial X-ray intelligent inspection equipment and core components. Its products and technologies are mainly applied in integrated circuits and electronic manufacturing, new energy batteries, casting and welding parts, and material inspection fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on X-ray full-industry chain technology research, including X-ray source design and manufacturing, intelligent X-ray inspection equipment, and X-ray imaging software. Key technologies include micro-focus X-ray sources, high-voltage generators, AI-based defect recognition algorithms, 3D/CT tomography, and digital radiography. Production methods involve standardized and customized manufacturing of X-ray intelligent inspection devices and modular assembly of core components like X-ray sources.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are from integrated circuit and electronic manufacturing, new energy battery production, and casting and welding parts industries. Notable clients include Infineon, Amphenol, Luxshare Precision, BYD Semiconductor, CATL, and BYD Lithium Battery. The company serves both domestic and international markets with a focus on high-precision industrial inspection needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in regions such as East China, South China, North China, Central China, and Southwest China. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production bases in Singapore, Malaysia, Hungary, and the United States, with overseas sales accounting for 8% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: WuXi Unicomp operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the industrial X-ray inspection supply chain. It manufactures core components like X-ray sources and assembles intelligent inspection equipment, supplying these to downstream manufacturers in electronics, battery, and automotive sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on developing series of industrial-grade X-ray sources, AI intelligent detection algorithms, and 3D/CT imaging technologies. It aims to achieve import substitution for core components, expand application scenarios, and enhance overseas market penetration. R&D efforts include breakthroughs in micro-focus and high-power X-ray sources, AI model upgrades, and expansion into new detection technologies such as optical, ultrasonic, magnetic powder, eddy current, energy spectrum, neutron, and quantum detection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of industrial X-ray intelligent inspection equipment and core components like X-ray sources. The company also earns from after-sales services and software solutions related to X-ray imaging and defect recognition. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales channels, supplemented by trade customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: WuXi Unicomp is a domestic leader in industrial X-ray intelligent inspection equipment, especially in integrated circuit and new energy battery sectors. It competes with international firms such as Hamamatsu and Thermo Fisher in the X-ray source market. The company holds a strong market position due to its comprehensive product portfolio, technological innovation, and expanding global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 739.5 million, a 25.89% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 143.3 million, up 25.44%. R&D investment accounted for 11.02% of revenue. The company has steadily increased its workforce to 972 employees, with a 10.58% growth in staff and a strong emphasis on R&D personnel (25.82%).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: WuXi Unicomp emphasizes its comprehensive control over the X-ray full-industry chain, proprietary core technologies, and AI-driven intelligent detection capabilities. It offers high-precision, high-efficiency X-ray inspection solutions tailored to critical industries, addressing domestic supply chain vulnerabilities by achieving import substitution. The company differentiates itself through advanced imaging software, AI algorithms, and a broad product range covering multiple industrial applications.
